messages:
mari: Quick kickoff  NebulaLabs integration + CloudBazaar marketplace tile aiming for 3-week runway. Deliverables: marketplace tile, joint 45m webinar (15m value prop + 25m demo + 5m Q&A), co-auth blog, and inbound routing into HubSpot/Segment. Need owner for routing, UTMs, and webinar copy. Who can take? :sparkles:

devon: I can own HubSpot routing + SLA. Question: prefer marketplace -> our reg page or native marketplace capture with redirect? Tracking-wise we prefer our page.

sasha: Ill take webinar landing + two email tracks (devs & platform). Drafts by Tue EOD. Will include audience selector on form.

leo: Ill handle marketplace tile assets and the 1200x600 hero. Need final tagline (<=10 words) and a 200-word blurb by Mon. Also confirm CTA target URL.

mari: Tagging owners noted. Devon please post the routing skeleton and property mappings. Sasha, include hidden utm fields and contact.audience. Leo, hold off on hero until we finalize tagline.

devon: Routing skeleton (HubSpot/Segment mapping):
```json
{
  "workflow":"nebula_cloudbazaar_inbound",
  "match":["utm_campaign=='nebula_launch_2025'","utm_source in ('cloudbazaar','email','webinar')"],
  "actions":["set contact.partner='nebulalabs'","set contact.entry=marketplace|webinar","assign:partner-queue","add_tag:partner_nebula"]
}
```
Will add lead scoring (attended + demo_request) and SLA 4h for assignment.

sasha: For emails: announce, reminder (48h), reminder (2h), and last-chance. Two subject variants per audience. Will A/B subject lines.

mari: Messaging note: we want one short benchmark stat for the blog and webinar opener (e.g., "50% latency reduction in embeddings on Nebula runtime")  can R&D confirm? @leo can you ask the Nebula PM for a short technical metric to quote?

leo: Reaching out to Nebula PM now for a 1-line metric and sandbox token for demo. Will update.

devon: Tracking checklist: utm_campaign=nebula_launch_2025, utm_source=cloudbazaar|email|webinar, utm_content=tile|card|email_variant, gclid passthrough. Segment event -> nebula_registrant, GA goal -> /thanks. Will push spec to the docs repo.

mari: Webinar logistics: date tentatively 2025-12-03 16:00 UTC. Launch-bot, can you reserve the slot?

launch-bot: Webinar slot tentatively reserved for 2025-12-03 16:00 UTC. Invite created pending confirmations.

sasha: UX question: single reg page with audience radio vs two separate pages? Single page preferred for marketplace CTA; will set contact.audience and branch nurture flows.

devon: Agree single page. If marketplace forces native capture, have it redirect to our confirm page with UTMs so we still own the lead. Also recommend passing a partner_token param for attribution.

mari: Deadlines: final tagline + blurb by Mon, routing + mapping doc by Tue noon, email/webinar drafts by Tue EOD, assets into design by Wed. Weekly check-ins Fri 9am PT. Flag blockers here. Thanks team :thumbsup:
